page.layout: One printed page, one text column in the centre; a woodcut ornament band above the heading; a large historiated initial at the start of the paragraph; no margin notes.

main_text.head: Ad Veros Amantesque Patriæ Belgas PRÆFATIO.

p.i: INsatiabilis auaritia, insana ambitio atqʒ immanis Hispanorum sæ-vitia ⁊ultimo hoc seculo quo exteris nationibus Dominari cæpere impri-mis apparuit.
Sensere eam inter gentiles innoscentes Indi, ac post ipsos inter Christianos miseri Belgæ, postquam Principis matrimonio delapsa ad eos Belgicarum provinciarum potestas, atque imperium.
Non latuit maiorum nostrorum prudentiam fore aliquando ⁊ut sanguineis lachrymis se Hispano cessisse Belgia deploraret.

page.notes: The initial "I" is a large woodcut letter, read as the first letter of "Insatiabilis" (set as "Nsatiabilis" in the scan). The "⁊" and "ꝯ"-type sign before "ut" is printed as a tironian-style mark; read as "ut" with a tilde-like sign, transcribed as ⁊ut. Final line "bus" is the continuation of "temporibus" split by the line end.
